title: Do you have questions about AI safety risks? We want to hear from you | CNN Business
text:
Source: CNN

The past several weeks have brought a rash of dire warnings about artificial intelligence posingexistential risksto humanity.

A string of workers haveresignedfrom leading AI labs over concerns around AI potentially causing human extinction. Some AI leaders have called toslow downits development. Yet others say these fears areoverblownand no new regulations are needed to keep AI safe.

CNN wants to better understand your big questions around these extreme AI safety risks. What feels unclear to you? What would you like to hear from the experts or AI leaders?
